reason: A cross-session memory plugin that prompts the main agent to save durable notes, provides memory_search and memory_write tools, and optionally combines substring retrieval with embeddings.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话记忆，通过自动提醒及 memory_search、memory_write 工具保存和检索按日期组织的工作区笔记。
summaries.en: Provides cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness by prompting note capture and offering memory_search and memory_write tools for dated workspace notes.

capabilities: Reads and searches stored Markdown memory files
Writes or updates daily Markdown memory files
Injects memory reminders into model system prompts
Optionally connects to an Ollama-compatible embedding service for vector retrieval
